clips.description: Binder switcher on Dad's home (mist): the menu lists Dad, Leo, Mia, Maya, Jonas, Biscuit, Sam; Maya picked (lavender home), menu again, Sam picked (dusk home). Joins at clip 2.5, 4.3 and 5.8 s, each inside a static hold (menu open or home settled). Ends on a 0.4 s held frame.

clips.description: Same moment in the light appearance (wallpapers read more strongly): Dad (mist) -> family list -> Maya (lavender) -> list -> Sam (dusk). Joins at 2.75, 4.75, 6.45 s inside static holds; 0.3 s held end.

clips.description: Settings > Background, scoped to Sam's binder, all nine tiles visible; each tap changes the backdrop: Morning mist, Lavender, Sea glass, Apricot, Blush, Sage, Linen, Dusk, Plain (about every 0.8 s from 0.85 s). A grid of tiles, not a horizontal slide. Eight joins, each inside the static hold between two taps (the taps were 2.6 s apart under load).

clips.description: Invite family sheet for Sam's binder: 'Share Sam's binder', real name Sam Costa, 'The invitation is for Sam' switched on (0.5 s; 'Sam's own phone will call it Your binder'), scroll, sam@example.com typed (4.0-7.9 s). The bottom card reads 'Sign in to iCloud to invite family' because no iCloud account is signed in: Invite was never shown or pressed. Joins at 1.5 and 3.95 s in static holds.

clips.description: Dad's binder: Family tapped (0.6 s) -> Family access: 'Shared with 2 people, 1 more invitation hasn't been accepted yet'; You (Owner), David (Co-manager), Claire (Viewer), Ruth (Co-manager, Invited, not joined yet); slow scroll (4.85-7.85 s) to What's shared. Names are the app's demo members, not the story family.

clips.description: Sam's binder (dusk), Documents: '2 papers in Sam's binder', Flat lease (Aug 31, 2027) and Car registration (May 14, 2027); the registration opens at 3.2 s (Expires, In 210 days, reminders), back at 6.7 s. 0.6 s held end. Also shows a 'Family IDs, 1 ID' row (Dad's licence) and the tab bar's 'Car registration' accessory.

clips.description: Family IDs: Driver's license (Dad, Nov 25), Passport (Leo, Jul 2, 2027), Passport (Mia, Sep 14, 2027), 'Reminders come 9, 6 and 3 months before each one expires.'; Mia's passport opens at 2.0 s, slow scroll (4.5-7.5 s) to 'We'll remind you 9 months, 6 months and 3 months before' with the chips. Alternative hot window 7.4-8.8 (the reminder chips).

clips.description: Emergency mode for the sample Mom (Eleanor Hughes) at the default text size: allergies, medications, conditions; slow scroll from 4.0 s to blood type, DNR, advance directive and the preferred hospital (Riverside Methodist Hospital, a real hospital name, visible about 6.5-8.0 s). No status bar (by design). 0.6 s held end.

clips.description: The same emergency view at the largest accessibility text size (AX5): Eleanor Hughes, 80 years old, born Mar 14, 1946, the allergies card; slow scroll from 4.5 s to medications. The size was switched live after emergency mode opened (the hook does not fire when the app starts at an accessibility size). 0.5 s held end.
